$Comment: The Burning Jack Helm: the Jack Helm charred black, sold at Old Jack's stall to players Revered with the Hallowed or Jack's Own with Old Jack, who trade in a Jack Helm for it (ShopEntries/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Jack_Helm.json), and sometimes paid by the Horseman's Hoard (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json). The same model as the Jack Helm under its own texture, a member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json), so it completes that set's first tier with either shield, and the helm of the Flaming Hallowed set (Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Hallowed.json). Its description names both sets. Every number is a step above the plain helm's, a little past the iron helm's: more Physical and Projectile resistance, more Health, twice the boost to favor gained with Old Jack (ReputationGain_Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack, Armor.StatModifiers, 20 is +20%), a ward against Fire of its own on top of the set's, and more durability. Light is the hotter glow it gives off in the hand or on the ground. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming the Jack Helm as Parent.
